notes: No mismatch -- Upland is a cloud-based enterprise/B2B software provider (cognitive business applications, knowledge management, contact-center software, project/IT management) and 'Enterprise Software & Security' fits well; kept as-is. Flagging that the business fundamentally looks closer in character to 'Distressed / Restructuring' (shrinking revenue, large GAAP impairments, Nasdaq minimum-market-value deficiency with a Jan 27 2027 cure deadline, a 1-for-10 reverse split in June 2026) -- noting this tension rather than changing the theme, since the company's product category is still enterprise software. SEC EDGAR, StockTitan and BusinessWire were unreachable via WebFetch in this sandbox; cash figure ($31.0M) is attributed to the company's own press release text as relayed by WebSearch; the debt figure is single-sourced to a third-party earnings summary (Quartr) and is NOT independently confirmed against the primary 10-Q.
